NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 02 OF 1974

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of1974, I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, do hereby approve the acquisition of theimmovable property, shown in the following Schedule as it is required by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board,for the resettlement of the residents of land which submerged by Basnagoda Reservoir constructed by Irrigation Departmentand need it to hand over Ruwanwella Divisional Secretary to implement Gampaha-Attanagalla-Minuwangoda DrinkingWater Project.

RAUFF HAKEEM,Minister of City Planning andWater Supply.Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply,No. 35, ‘Lakdiya Medura’,New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla,07th June, 2017.5/2/1/1288SCHEDULE

An allotment of land called Sunnycroft Estate Division 02 situated at the village of Sunnycroft Watta in theGrama Niladhari Division of No. 101C, Wahakula in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ruwanwella in Kegalle Districtand containing in total extent of about 24 acres, 39.3 perches and bounded as follows :—

North by:Remaining portion of the Sunnycraft Estate ;East by:Remaining portion of the Sunnycraft Estate ;South by:Remaining portion of the Sunnycraft Estate ;West by:Stream (Interim Canal connected to Basnagoda Oya).
Name and address of the claimant: 01. Chief Exceutive Officer,Malwatta Plantations Ltd.,No. 280, Dam Street,Colombo 12.07 -350
